status: Retrospective exploratory evaluation; frozen before new semantic scores, after historical WER inspection
cohort: official qual_dev, reused; NOT independent test
source_normalization: NFKC+casefold+Unicode_word_tokens for WER; original strings for semantic evaluation
fact_weights: one atomic fact, one vote; macro per description primary, micro counts supplementary
unclear_policy: Keep in denominator; report separately, never silently drop
manual_scope: Fixed length-stratified 30 descriptions, all available model/control outputs; no automatic SPICE or LLM fact judge

bertscore.length_policy: Preflight every complete reference and candidate with actual scorer tokenizer; abort entire score run on overflow, never truncate or drop samples
bertscore.baseline_policy: Raw score plus empirical unrelated-description reference. No verified official model-specific rescale table bundled; no invented baseline. Rescaling would require a separately frozen protocol version.
bertscore.interpretation: Auxiliary similarity, NOT semantic accuracy percentage or factual-correctness guarantee

references.receiver_shuffled: Actual saved shuffled receiver outputs; NOT substituted source descriptions
references.unrelated_description: Fixed source-description derangement, evaluator calibration only; NOT a communication method or theoretical lower bound
references.native_BART: Saved full native source-memory reconstruction; privileged diagnostic, NOT theoretical upper bound or equal-resource communication baseline
references.digital: NOT_RUN: requires identical source, total symbols, power, channel, overhead and failure policy; never substitute source text and mark digital perfect

decisions: No automatic quality promotion; historical WER/QUALITY_STOP remain unchanged; no universal similarity threshold
communication_claim: Graceful degradation versus same-resource digital transmission is an untested hypothesis; this clean evaluation cannot establish it
